description: Vehicle types and demand mixes. Every numeric parameter cites its source in 'sources'; values marked 'assumed' have no measured Indian source and should be calibrated against observations before being presented as representative. Mix shares are SCENARIO ASSUMPTIONS, not measurements of any real city.

sources.sumo_defaults: SUMO 'Vehicle Type Parameter Defaults' (https://sumo.dlr.de/docs/Vehicle_Type_Parameter_Defaults.html), first row per vClass: passenger 5.0 x 1.8 m, accel 2.6, decel 4.5, emergencyDecel 9; motorcycle 2.2 x 0.9 m, accel 6, decel 10, emergencyDecel 10; bus 12 x 2.5 m, accel 1.2, decel 4, emergencyDecel 7, maxSpeed 85 km/h; minGap 2.5 m for all three. SUMO notes accel/decel are 'convenient' values, not vehicle maxima.
sources.bajaj_re: Bajaj RE three-wheeler official specification page (https://www.bajajauto.com/three-wheelers/re/specifications): overall length 2635 mm, width 1300 mm; Bajaj RE CNG brochure: max speed 65 km/h.
sources.hero_splendor_plus: Hero Splendor Plus (common Indian 100 cc commuter motorcycle), dealer/spec listings: length 2000 mm, width 720 mm, top speed about 87 km/h (Team-BHP spec page).
sources.assumed: No published source used; engineering assumption, to be calibrated.
sources.sumo_emergency_measured: Values read back through TraCI (vehicletype.getLength/getWidth/getAccel/getDecel/getEmergencyDecel/getMinGap) from SUMO 1.27.1 for a vType declaring only vClass='emergency': 6.5 x 2.16 m, minGap 2.5, accel 2.6, decel 4.5, emergencyDecel 9, speedFactor 1.0.

car.note: Legacy Phase-1 car type, kept identical for comparability with earlier runs.

car_in.source: sumo_defaults (passenger). Speed is limited by the road speed limits.

motorcycle_in.source: length/width/maxSpeed (87 km/h): hero_splendor_plus; accel/decel/emergencyDecel/minGap: sumo_defaults (motorcycle). latAlignment only matters when the sublane model is enabled.

auto_rickshaw.source: length/width/maxSpeed (65 km/h): bajaj_re. accel 1.0 and decel 4.0 / emergencyDecel 7: assumed (no published value found). SUMO has no rickshaw vehicle class, so vClass 'passenger' is used for road permissions; emissions use the passenger default and are NOT representative of a 3-wheeler.

bus_in.source: sumo_defaults (bus). Buses are modelled as through traffic without bus stops.

ambulance.source: sumo_emergency_measured. No 'bluelight' device is configured: the ambulance obeys red signals and speed limits like other traffic, so any travel-time change comes only from signal priority. Simulation only - not a model of real emergency-vehicle behaviour.

india_urban_assumed.note: ASSUMED illustrative mix with two-wheelers as the largest group. Not derived from counts at any real location; replace with observed classified counts for a study area.
